notes.title: Game update January 2025
notes.content:
########################
#IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ
########################

Patch Notes 

This game update includes the following updates & changes

#######################
#GAMEPLAY CHANGES
#######################
Weather forecast now updates after FP2 and Qualifying during a race weekend to better simulate the changing of days 
from Friday - Sunday
Updated display of team expectations
Added rider season form to rider screen
Added indicators to players riders stats to show changes from training etc
Added rider rumors screen with updates about teams interested in certain riders
MGP3 teams now prioritise signing upcoming riders with a view to finding future stars
Added rider history page
Added option to skip pre-season testing
#######################
#GAME EDITOR
#######################

No changes

#######################
#SAVED GAMES
#######################

**** THIS UPDATE REQUIRES A NEW GAME TO BE STARTED - LOADING EXISTING SAVED GAMES WILL CAUSE THE GAME TO CRASH ****

notes.title: Game Update 31/11/2024
notes.content:
########################
#IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ
########################

Patch Notes 

This game update includes the following updates & changes

#######################
#GAMEPLAY CHANGES
#######################
Updated bike graphics
All riders tyre display added in raceview, hide/show F7/F8
Riders now have larger stat gains if 'Improve' is set to Yes in game editor
Increased rate of rider fitness gain when on track
More realistic rider transfers - riders now work up from the lower classes to higher classes.
On track accidents now scaled a lot more to ambient temperature, track conditions and tyre wear
Balanced engine performance in MGP1 class
Additional indictors on rider & staff market screens
Fixed display of rider happiness
Riders will now not re-sign for the players team if they are unhappy
Ending a session early now correctly updates the time for any weather changes
Rider setup suggestions added to rider setup screen during practice sessions

#######################
#GAME EDITOR
#######################

No changes

#######################
#SAVED GAMES
#######################

Saved games should work fine with this update

notes.title: Patch Notes 30/10/2024
notes.content:
########################
#IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ
########################

Patch Notes 30/10/2024

This game update includes the following updates & changes

#######################
#GAMEPLAY CHANGES
#######################

All 17 circuit graphics updated
Rider energy use scaled to ambient temperature & weather conditions
Added option at season start to change circuit order to customise season
Adjusted first lap pace so riders don't lose too much time at race start
Rider stats reduce more realistically if no training selected/rider injured
Wet tyre performance optimised for amount of surface water on track
Added rider split time information during test & practice sessions

#######################
#GAME EDITOR
#######################

Custom data from previous game versions WILL NOT load in the game editor and cannot be used
Changed some countries and added more South American countries
Added option to set rider contract length to 1 or 2 years

#######################
#SAVED GAMES
#######################

Saved games should work fine with this update

notes.title: Patch notes 2/9/2024
notes.content:
Small update to correct screen progression after terminating a riders contract
Rider setup XP in testing scaled depending on length of pre season test

notes.title: Patch notes 22/8/24
notes.content:
This update is mainly finalising button/text placement in readiness for Spanish localisation in next update

Other smaller changes are:-

Adjusted tyre wear rates for medium/hard rear tyres (Player & ai)
Update to the requirements for ai teams signing riders
Modified rate of morale improvement for riders doing coaching training (slightly increased)

notes.title: Patch notes 15/8/24
notes.content: If anyone has had a problem with the race order not being displayed correctly if a rider is injured, then this small patch will fix this issue.

notes.title: Patch Notes 14/8/24
notes.content: Small update finalizing button/text placement in readiness for addition of Spanish language text

notes.title: Patch notes 6/8/24
notes.content:
This patch includes the following fixes/updates

Fixed rare issue with displaying manager job situation correctly
Fixed issue with naming regen riders & staff
Managers under pressure now displays correctly
Fixed rare issue when ai managers stats didn't update after a race
Added option to simulate a race from event details screen (skip practice/qual etc)

notes.title: Patch notes 27/7/24
notes.content:
Changed start menu, it now has a settings button that allows audio changes and option to play in windowed mode.

Added option at event details screen to select a shorter race weekend which has fewer sessions
